description.narrative:
Insatsen är i form av kärnstöd till organisationen Women’s Learning Partnership for Rights, Development, and Peace (WLP) som är en koalition bestående av 20 autonoma kvinnorättsorganisationer med ett sekretariat i Bethesda, USA. WLPs partnerorganisationer är baserad i länder över hela det globala syd, med det gemensamma uppdraget att förändra maktrelationer och främja demokrati, jämlikhet, fred och hållbar utveckling.
WLP:s partnerskapsmodell och metodik använder ett decentraliserat, samhällsbaserat tillvägagångssätt för att sprida kunskap om kvinnors rättigheter, demokratiska idéer och metoder, och för att öka WLP:s partners organisatoriska och strategiska möjligheter att påverka beslutsfattande på lokal, nationell, regional och internationell nivå. WLP har tre övergripande målområden för verksamheten i enlighet med deras Strategiska plan, med tydligt definierade uppföljningsbara mål. Målområdena är Ledarskap, mobilisering av kvinnorättsröreslen och stärka det civila samhället

The contribution is in the form of core support to the organisation Women’s Learning Partnership for Rights, Development, and Peace (WLP). WLP is an international women’s rights organization comprised of a partnership of 20 autonomous women’s rights organizations, primarily from transitioning and developing societies with WLP’s secretariat located in Maryland, USA. WLP’s mission is to transform power relations and promote justice, equality, peace, and sustainable development by strengthening the feminist movement. This is done through curriculum and resource development, training, capacity development, advocacy and movement building while promoting and sustaining leadership that is participatory and replicable. WLP has three areas of impact. Under each outcome and obejctive there are several goals to be achieved. The three areas of impact are Leadership, Mobilising the women´s movement and Civil society strengthening.

WLP has three areas of impact. Under each outcome and obejctive there are several goals to be achieved (please find more information in the application).
1. Leadership Outcome: FEMINIST LEADERSHIP Empower feminist leaders to fully participate in civic, economic, and political life in the Global South.
Objective 1:WLP will increase womens engagement in the political process and in decisionmaking positions. In four years, more women will be engaged in the political process and in decisionmaking positions in the communities where WLP works and beyond.
Objective 2: WLP will promote the adoption and application of feminist principles to advance rights and justice. In four years, in the communities where WLP works and beyond, leaders are using feminist principles to advance rights and justice in their spheres of influence
Objective 3: WLP will promote and safeguard gender justice. In four years, the communities where WLP works will promote and safeguard gender justice. Objective 4: WLP will empower and mobilize young leaders to advocate for gender justice. In four years, more young leaders will advocate for gender justice in the communities where WLP works and beyond.
2. Movements Outcome: MOBILIZING THE WOMENS MOVEMENT Accelerate movements for justice and ending violence and discrimination against women and girls.In four years:
Objective 1: WLP will educate, train, and mobilize individuals and CSOs to contribute to the success of legal reforms that promote gender justice. In four years, in the communities where WLP works and beyond, there will be successful legal reforms to promote gender justice.
Objective 2: WLP will increase the impact of local, national, and regional women's human rights movements by facilitating greater coordination at the regional level. In four years, in the regions where WLP works, local, national, and regional women's human rights movements will have more impact because of increased coordination at the regional level.
Objective 3: WLP will build capacity and drive greater collaboration among activists and CSOs to collectively advocate for policies that address gender equality, peacebuilding, democratic values, climate justice, and human rights. In four years, CSOs af iliated with WLP partners in their regions will be collaborating with each other and WLP to bring about genderresponsive policies.
Objective 4: WLP will collect, record, and share the important history and accomplishments of women to inspire and catalyze feminist movements around the world. In four years, the history and accomplishments of women in the Global South, particularly from the regions where WLP works, will fuel feminist movements.
3. Civil Society Outcome: CIVIL SOCIETY STRENGTHENING Propel the collective power of womenled civil society organizations to protect and advance democracy, human rights, and gender justice.
Objective 1: WLP will strengthen the capacity of partner organizations in program implementation, organizational development, and mobilization, including to more effectively work in changing or difficult environments. In four years, the organizations that WLP engages with will be more effective in program implementation and more resilient to crisis situations.
Objective 2: WLP will empower civil society organizations to effectively serve as robust defenses against poverty, corruption, authoritarianism, discrimination, and violence. In four years, CSOs in the communities where WLP works and beyond will be able to serve as bulwarks against poverty, corruption, authoritarianism, discrimination, and violence.
Objective 3: WLP will support women's rights activists and leaders operating in regions where civil society faces significant challenges by building and supporting impactful coalitions and movements for women's rights. In four years, human and womens rights activists working for freedom and rights in places where civil society is not able to function will have built efective alliances and movements for rights.
